tha-ap474:1.1: Maṇipūjaka.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū / vivekakāmo sambuddho gacchate anilañjase. // //
tha-ap474:2.1: Avidūre Himavato mahājātassaro ahū / tattha me bhavanaṃ āsi puññakammena *saṃ*yutaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:3.1: Bhavanā abhinikkhamma addasaṃ lokanāsanaṃ / indīvaraṃ va jalitam ādittaṃ va hutāsanaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:4.1: Vicinaṃ nāddasaṃ pupphaṃ pūjayissan ti nāyakaṃ / Sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā avandiṃ satthuno ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:5.1: Mama sīse maṇiṃ gayha pūjayiṃ lokanāyakaṃ / imāya maṇipūjāya vipāko *hotu bhadda*ko. // //
tha-ap474:6.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / antalikkhe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap474:7.1: ‘So te ijjhatu saṅkappo labhassu vipulaṃ sukhaṃ / imāya maṇipūjāya anubhohi mahāyasaṃ.' // //
tha-ap474:8.1: Idaṃ *vatvāna* bhagavā jalajuttamanāmako / agamāsi Buddhaseṭṭho yattha cittaṃ paṇīhitaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:9.1: Saṭṭhikappāni devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ / anekasatakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:10.1: Pubbakammaṃ sarantassa devabhūtassa me sato / maṇi nibbattate mayhaṃ ālokakaraṇo mama. // // Chalāsītisahassāni
tha-ap474:12.1: Aḷārapamhā hasulā susoññā tanumajjhimā / parivārenti maṃ niccaṃ maṇipūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:13.1: Sovaṇṇamayā maṇimayā lohitaṅkamayā tathā / bhaṇḍā katākatā bhonti yadicchāya pilandhanā. // //
tha-ap474:14.1: Kūṭāgārā guhā rammā sayanañ ca mahārahaṃ / mama saṅkappam aññāya nibbattanti yadicchakaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:15.1: Lābhā tesaṃ suladdhaṃ va ye labhanti upassutiṃ / puññakkhettaṃ manussānam osadhaṃ sabbapāṇinaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:16.1: Mayham pi sukataṃ kammaṃ yo 'haṃ addakkhi nāyakaṃ / vinipātā pamutto 'mhi patto ca acalaṃ padaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:17.1: Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ / samantā sattaratanā āloko hoti me sadā. // //
tha-ap474:18.1: Tāy' eva maṇipūjāya anubhotvāna sampadā / ñāṇāloko mayā diṭṭho patto 'mhi acalaṃ padaṃ. // //
tha-ap474:19.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ maṇim abhipūjayuṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi maṇipūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap474:23.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Maṇipūjako thero i. g. a-ti.
